name: Fleet Compliance OS – Document Expiry, e-Challan, Dispatch Gate & Driver Upload Loop

parameters.content:
## 🚛 Fleet Compliance OS

For Indian fleet owners and transport managers who track RC, insurance, PUC, fitness and permit dates in a spreadsheet, and find out a document lapsed when a truck is stopped or a challan arrives.

### How it works
Every morning each vehicle's document dates are checked, and pending e-challans are pulled from your challan provider. Each vehicle gets a risk score, and any vehicle with an expired document is blocked from dispatch, with ops told in Slack. Drivers get an AI-written Telegram reminder at 30, 15, 7, 3 and 0 days, a ClickUp renewal task is opened, and fleet managers get a daily email digest.

The loop closes on Telegram. A driver sends a photo of the renewed document to the bot, GPT-4o reads it, and if the vehicle number and new expiry check out, the register is updated and the driver gets a confirmation.

### Setup steps
1. Create a Google Sheet with **Fleet_Register** and **Alert_Log** tabs. The register needs one row per vehicle, with expiry columns and the driver's Telegram chat ID.
2. Connect Google Sheets, OpenAI, Telegram (bot), Slack, ClickUp and Gmail.
3. Add your e-challan API as Header Auth and set its URL in **Check Pending e-Challans**.
4. Replace `YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID`, the Slack channel and the ClickUp list, then run the daily scan once manually.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – Daily Scan & Expiry Check

parameters.content:
## 🗓️ Daily Scan & Expiry Check
At 7 AM every vehicle's RC, insurance, PUC, fitness and permit dates are checked. Alerts go out at 30, 15, 7, 3 and 0 days, and the alert log makes sure each stage fires only once.

## 🚦 e-Challan & Risk Score
Pulls pending e-challans for each vehicle from your provider, then gives the vehicle a 0–100 risk score. Any expired document blocks the vehicle from dispatch.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – AI Alerts & Renewal Tasks

parameters.content:
## 🧠 AI Alerts & Renewal Tasks
GPT-4o-mini writes a short Telegram message for the driver about what's due. A ClickUp renewal task is created once per document, and every alert is logged.

## 📧 Fleet Manager Digest
Each fleet manager gets one email listing blocked vehicles, upcoming renewals and new challans.

## ⛔ Dispatch Gate
When a vehicle flips between allowed and blocked, the register is updated and ops are told in Slack, so nobody dispatches a truck with lapsed papers.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – Driver Upload & AI Read

parameters.content:
## 📸 Driver Upload & AI Read
Drivers renew by sending a photo of the new document to the Telegram bot. Messages from unknown chats or without an image are ignored. GPT-4o reads the type, vehicle number and expiry date.

## ✅ Validate & Update
The new expiry must beat both today and the date on file, the vehicle number must match and the photo must be clear. Good uploads update the register, ops get a Slack note to spot-check and the driver is told. Otherwise they're asked to resend.

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
Keep the challan API key in Header Auth and the Telegram bot token as a credential. The bot only accepts photos from chat IDs in your register. Document photos include personal details, so don't forward them outside ops.

values.content:
You write fleet compliance alerts for an Indian transport company. Be factual; never invent fines, dates or documents. Return ONLY JSON:
{
 "driver_message": "plain text, max 700 chars: greeting with driver name, each document/challan in one line, what the driver must do. If dispatch_status is BLOCKED, say clearly in the first line that the vehicle must NOT be driven until renewed. End with: 'Renewed? Send a clear photo of the new document here with the vehicle number in the caption.' Then repeat the core message in simple Hindi.",
 "manager_summary": "2 sentences for the fleet manager, mention risk level",
 "task_title": "Renewal: <vehicle_no> – <docs>",
 "task_description": "markdown checklist per document. Insurance: compare quotes, renew, upload policy. PUC: visit authorised PUC centre. Fitness: book RTO inspection on Parivahan. Permit: apply for renewal on Parivahan/state portal. RC: renewal/re-registration at RTO. Challans: verify and pay on echallan.parivahan.gov.in or contest.",
 "priority": 1-4 (1 = urgent if BLOCKED, anything expired, or <= 3 days),
 "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD = earliest expiry minus 2 days, or today if already expired"
}
